How: 2 DHL staff unpack each container in the loose-container zone at door R1
Cons: Heavy manual handling, training, peak days need 2 crews

How: Contractor crew unpacks and palletises in the same zone, paid per container
Pros: No own labour or peak staffing; specialist speed and safety; cost scales with containers
Cons: Per-container fee (no public price - quote needed); booking coordination

How: Container unpacked and palletised near the port; arrives as a palletised trailer
Cons: Extra transport and handling cost; ~1 day longer lead time; less control
